# LLM Integration Gotchas

> Known gotchas when integrating LLM / reasoning-model APIs (streaming chat completions, tool calling, SSE parsing). Provider-general; examples use OpenRouter's OpenAI-compatible HTTP. Load all HIGH entries before writing agent-loop or LLM-streaming code.

## Entries

- [Reasoning models spiral silently in delta.reasoning](reasoning-model-spiral.md): Reasoning models stream chain-of-thought in `delta.reasoning` / `delta.reasoning_content`, separate from `delta.content` and `delta.tool_calls`. A spiral floods reasoning while emitting zero content and zero tool calls, so the turn looks like a silent empty hang until timeout. Count reasoning deltas and warn on the signature. HIGH.
